changelog:
golang-swagger v1.1.0

- Added path restriction: skill now only applies to `*.go` files (`paths: [**/*.go]`).
- Expanded tool compatibility metadata; now lists support for Codex and more LSP/tools.
- Updated metadata and version numbers to reflect v1.1.0.
- Clarified compatibility, dependencies, and usage setup in the SKILL.md.
- Removed legacy skill-card.md file.
summary: Golang OpenAPI/Swagger documentation with swaggo/swag — annotation comments (@Summary, @Param, @Success, @Router, @Security), swag init code generation, framework integrations (gin, echo, fiber, chi, net/http), security definitions (Bearer/JWT, OAuth2, API key), and struct tags (swaggertype, enums, example, swaggerignore). Apply when adding or maintaining Swagger/OpenAPI docs in a Go project, or when the codebase imports github.com/swaggo/swag, github.com/swaggo/gin-swagger, github.com/swaggo/echo-swagger, github.com/swaggo/http-swagger, or github.com/swaggo/files.
